text:
Lizzy: quick QA pass on suppression modal and channel preview — found a couple a11y + copy nits while testing in mac/chrome :thinking_face:
Omar: what happened? steps?
Lizzy: Open alert → Edit suppression → Tab into channel selector → pick a channel → focus ends up behind the modal (page).
Sam: that screams missing focus-trap. modal should trap focus and restore it on close.
Maya: also noticed Enter while navigating suggestions closes the modal instead of selecting. Enter should select; Esc should close.
a11y-bot: Scan: missing role="dialog" and aria-modal on suppression modal; focus not set on open in ~7% of runs.
Lizzy: chips in the channel list (compact) have low contrast when selected (~2.6:1). fails AA for small text.
Omar: modal can use full pills instead of compact to improve contrast and hit area — keep compact only in matrix view.
Maya: will update mocks to full pills in modal + add inline preview (3 pills + "+N more").
Sam: I'll take keyboard fixes (focus-trap, Enter handling) and add e2e tests.
Lizzy: copy tweak: change "Preview channels" → "Preview notifications" and add small timezone indicator near Start/End times (user-local + "Change timezone").
Omar: tooltip for header instead of long column title: keep "Channels" + focusable help icon with "Destinations for notifications" copy.
Lizzy: Action items: 1) add role="dialog" + aria-modal and set focus on open 2) implement focus-trap and restore focus 3) fix Enter behavior 4) swap compact → full pills in modal 5) improve chip contrast / add border 6) change preview copy + inline pill preview 7) add keyboard-accessible tooltip for channels
Maya: I'll upload updated mock + copy today. Sam: ping when PR is up and I'll review contrast specs.
